Associate Software Engineer – Backend (2026 batch)
About the role
You will build APIs for our payments platform using Kubernetes and Kafka.
Requirements
• B.Tech / B.E. in Computer Science, IT or ECE (2025 or 2026 batch)
• 0-1 years of experience; freshers welcome
• Strong knowledge of Python or Java
• Hands-on experience with SQL and REST APIs
• Understanding of data structures and algorithms
• Minimum 60% throughout academics, no active backlogs
Nice to have
• Experience with Docker and AWS
• Exposure to Django or Spring Boot is a plus
